parts.text:
We offer a range of business solutions across five main categories:

**Fiber Internet (FTTP)**
- **Business Fiber 1 Gbps (FIB-1G)**: Symmetrical 1 Gbps speeds.
- **Business Fiber 5 Gbps (FIB-5G)**: Symmetrical 5 Gbps speeds.
- **Business Fiber 10 Gbps (FIB-10G)**: Symmetrical 10 Gbps speeds.

**Coax Internet (HFC/DOCSIS 3.1)**
- **Business Internet 200 Mbps (COAX-200M)**: 200 Mbps Download / 20 Mbps Upload.
- **Business Internet 500 Mbps (COAX-500M)**: 500 Mbps Download / 50 Mbps Upload.
- **Business Internet 1 Gbps (COAX-1G)**: 1 Gbps Download / 100 Mbps Upload.

**Voice (VoIP/SIP/Cloud)**
- **Business Voice Basic (VOICE-BAS)**: 1-5 lines, G.711 HD Voice.
- **Business Voice Standard (VOICE-STD)**: 5-20 lines, G.711 HD Voice.
- **Business Voice Enterprise (VOICE-ENT)**: 20-100+ lines, SIP Trunking.
- **Unified Communications (UCaaS) (VOICE-UCAAS)**: Unlimited users, Cloud-based.

**SD-WAN**
- **SD-WAN Essentials (SDWAN-ESS)**: Up to 250 Mbps throughput, 1-5 sites.
- **SD-WAN Professional (SDWAN-PRO)**: Up to 1 Gbps throughput, 5-25 sites.
- **SD-WAN Enterprise (SDWAN-ENT)**: Up to 10 Gbps throughput, 25-500+ sites.

**Business Mobile (4G LTE/5G)**
- **Business Mobile Basic (MOB-BAS)**: 10 GB/month on 4G LTE.
- **Business Mobile Unlimited (MOB-UNL)**: Unlimited data on 5G Nationwide.
- **Business Mobile Premium (MOB-PREM)**: Unlimited Premium data on 5G Ultra Wideband.

**Next Steps:**
- Would you like to see pricing and availability for any of these products?
- I can also show you detailed specifications or compare specific options for you.

parts.text:
**SD-WAN Essentials (SDWAN-ESS)**
- Category: SD-WAN
- Technology: SD-WAN
- Speeds: Up to 250 Mbps throughput, 1-5 sites
- Description: Entry-level SD-WAN for small multi-site businesses with basic traffic optimization
- Features:
  - Application-aware routing
  - Dual-WAN failover
  - Basic QoS and traffic shaping
  - Cloud-managed portal
  - Zero-touch provisioning
  - SD-WAN gateway appliance included
  - Business support

**SD-WAN Professional (SDWAN-PRO)**
- Category: SD-WAN
- Technology: SD-WAN
- Speeds: Up to 1 Gbps throughput, 5-25 sites
- Description: Advanced SD-WAN with integrated security and multi-cloud connectivity
- Features:
  - Application-aware routing with AI optimization
  - Multi-WAN failover (up to 4 links)
  - Advanced QoS with 8 traffic classes
  - Integrated firewall and IPS
  - Cloud-managed portal with analytics
  - Multi-cloud connectivity (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  - Zero-touch provisioning
  - SD-WAN gateway appliance included
  - 99.9% uptime SLA
  - Priority 24/7 support

**SD-WAN Enterprise (SDWAN-ENT)**
- Category: SD-WAN
- Technology: SD-WAN
- Speeds: Up to 10 Gbps throughput, 25-500+ sites
- Description: Enterprise-class SD-WAN with full SASE integration, global backbone, and managed services
- Features:
  - AI-driven application optimization
  - Multi-WAN failover with sub-second switchover
  - Full SASE integration (ZTNA, SWG, CASB)
  - Global private backbone network
  - Advanced analytics and AIOps
  - Multi-cloud connectivity with private peering
  - Managed service option available
  - Custom traffic policies per application
  - 99.99% uptime SLA
  - Dedicated account manager
  - 24/7 NOC monitoring

We do not currently offer a 100 Gbps fiber plan. The highest bandwidth tier available on our network is the 10 Gbps plan.

**Business Fiber 10 Gbps (FIB-10G)**
- Category: Fiber Internet
- Technology: FTTP
- Speeds: 10 Gbps Download / 10 Gbps Upload (Symmetrical)
- Description: Enterprise-grade symmetrical fiber designed for large enterprises, data-intensive industries, and organizations requiring carrier-grade performance.
- Features:
  - Dedicated account manager
  - Enterprise redundancy hardware
  - Strongest SLA in the portfolio (99.9%–99.95% uptime)
  - Low latency (5–15 ms)
  - Dedicated fiber strand (not shared)
  - Typical provisioning lead time: 15–30 business days
